cases.requirement: Leased ingress -> exact immutable envelope -> guarded native/applied execution -> real worker/wire -> real receipt; final release keeps native and recipient proof separate; same-grant re-press is barred until settlement and succeeds after it.
The submitting connection remains live; established termination of the exact recipient supplies only the recipient half. Missing route, failed send and unreadability do not substitute.
Withhold each required proof in turn; neither bytes alone nor completion observation clears the other obligation or permits re-press.
Pending focus refuses, applied focus permits; foreign/replacement histories refuse at the actual participating producer.
One runner retains the exact key/XKB history across turns; no re-created or foreign history can qualify.
Motion/axis, StateOnly and thaw preserve the decided order; deferred work cannot reselect or restamp at delivery.
Duplicate/join and survivor release do not repeat effects; the last-holder release targets the original recipient.
Full queues and exact reservation bounds refuse before acceptance while current and remainder retain their own credits.
Return/error/unwind preserves current item, remainder, completion and origin in durable custody.
Partial/unknown transmission is not replayed; enqueued work retries observation only; refused publication remains owed.
Unreadable state remains legible and excluded where necessary; it does not become empty or settled.
Exercise actual cleanup for PublishMetadataRule, AdmitSurface, ConfigureSurface, SetPresentationState, RestorePresentationState, FocusSurface, ClearFocus, CloseSurface and WithdrawSurface.
Foreign/colliding origins refuse; repeated recovery keeps credit and outcome identity; include native sibling-grab continuations.
Real producers become reachable after readiness; admission/revocation participates in execution.
Refused spawn, failure after spawn, and departure inside startup preserve the exact handle and distinguish attempted from unattempted work.
Ordinary departure and unwind have distinct diagnostics; only join establishes quiescence and its actual panic outcome.
Destroy a registration over a controlled live worker only after the safe destruction boundary is implemented; stop remains reachable and custody persists through collection.
Explicit shutdown, service error and unwind close real ingress/transports while unresolved work, evidence and capabilities remain owned outside the exiting frame.
Old cleanup/captured failures cannot affect a successor, and unfinished cleanup cannot release the number.

Every dequeue is charged, idle/blocked polls spend no starts, cleanup reserve/donation rules hold, and the independent watchdog covers execution-guard acquisition without joining a stuck worker on supervision.
